replace.with: Checks App Store and Play listing texts for prices and other platforms. Use when writing or changing store texts or release notes. Not for exporting lists (run-list-export).
Keeps every store listing text free of the two things review rejects most: prices and other platforms.
1. **No prices in any listing text.** Prices differ per storefront and change, and both stores reject metadata that states them.
2. **No other platforms.** Naming the other store in a listing breaks review guidelines and blocks the release.
Write each text in `store/<locale>/<field>.txt`, one file per field and locale.
Every field of every locale has its text file.
**"Only 1.99 for Premium!" in the description.** Put prices in the store price table, never in the text.
Field limits, the two review rules and a worked listing
- `run-list-export` - exporting lists, which has nothing to do with listing texts.
The review rules for listing texts. Read it before writing any text.
Both stores reject listing metadata that states prices or names other platforms.
"Plan your day with lists and reminders." passes; "Only 1.99, also on the other store" fails twice.
a listing text states a price
Remove the price; the store shows it from the price table.
